HATMAGICIAN2-BRAND_POWER.description:
• Each target can have at most one Brand.
• Brands have Passive and Evoke effects.
• Applying a Brand will [gold]Evoke[/gold] the existing Brand.
• When conditions are met, the applied Brand will [gold]Blend[/gold] with the existing Brand into a new Brand and trigger its Blend effect. Blending rules:
• Purple = Red + Blue  
• Orange = Red + Yellow
• White = Yellow + Blue  
• Rainbow = Red + Yellow + Blue
• Only applying Red, Yellow, or Blue can trigger Blending.
• Brands can penetrate Artifact.
• Detailed effects of Blended Brands can be viewed on the starter relic.
• Basic mechanic tips can be disabled in baselib settings; recommended to do so once familiar.
